notices.title: Stratford (London) Rail Station
notices.detail: MILDMAY LINE: Sunday 27 September, after 2215, no service between Camden Road and Stratford. Rail replacement buses will run as follows: Service S: Camden Road - Holloway Road (Piccadilly line) - Highbury & Islington - Canonbury - Dalston Junction (for Dalston Kingsland) - Hackney Central - Homerton - Hackney Wick - Stratford. For Caledonian Road & Barnsbury use local bus route 274 to/from Camden Road or walk to/from Highbury & Islington. Some buses continue on request westbound only from Camden Road as follows: Camden Road - Kentish Town West - Gospel Oak (bus stop in Southampton Road) - Hampstead Heath - Finchley Road Tube (for Finchley Road & Frognal) - West Hampstead - Brondesbury (bus stops in Kilburn High Road) - Queen's Park (walk/local buses for Brondesbury Park) - Kensal Rise - Willesden Junction - Acton Central - South Acton - Gunnersbury - Kew Gardens (Royal Botanic Gardens) - Richmond. Last through trains: Richmond to Stratford 2110; Camden Road to Stratford 2203; Stratford to Richmond 2201; Stratford to Clapham Junction 22:08

notices.title: Stratford Underground Station
notices.detail: CENTRAL LINE: Saturday 26 September & Sunday 27 September, no service (including Saturday Night Tube) between Liverpool Street and Woodford / Newbury Park. Replacement buses operate. For Night journeys to Wanstead, Redbridge and Gants Hill, please use Night Bus Route N8.
